theme.description: Minimalist corporate dashboard with industrial liquid glass elements. Deep obsidian background allows the bright frosted glass panels to stand out, evoking precision, manufacturing, and high-tech management.

headings.usage: Corporate, clean, technical. Used for all dashboard metrics, titles, and structural headers.

body.usage: Highly legible font for data-heavy tables, forms, and CRM details.

rules: Labels must be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
The jump between a heading and its subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.

background.description: Deep Slate/Obsidian to give the industrial metallic feel. Never pure black.

accent.description: Signal Orange and Volt Yellow for high-visibility industrial actions, alerts, and KPIs.

rules: Avoid Teal Green or Teal Blue entirely.
Hover state color must be a lighter hue of ACTIVE state color.
No complete transparent backgrounds on interactive elements with content underneath.
Never use pure #000000. Always tint neutrals.

liquid_glass.usage: Apply to main dashboard panels, sidebar, and floating AI assistant widgets.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity-10) on the background to make the environment feel physical and industrial.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Smooth rounded corners (rounded-3xl for big panels, rounded-xl for inner cards) to mimic the surface tension of liquid.

dashboard_grid.strategy: High Density Grid with liquid glass panels.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing (p-6, p-8) inside liquid glass containers to prevent text collision. Use grid layout directly on children.
layouts.alignment: Left-align dense content and tables. Mobile-first responsive always.

components.sidebar: Floating liquid glass panel (m-4, rounded-3xl) detached from the edge. Include language toggle (RU/EN).
components.tables: Cardless style inside glass panels. Row hover with 'hover:bg-white/5'. Headers use IBM Plex Sans, uppercase, muted.
components.avatars: Custom round liquid glass wrapper for employee profile pictures. Includes UID badge overlay for access cards.
components.ai_assistant: Floating widget in bottom right. Deep blur, signal orange accent ping animation (GigaChat integration point).
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary buttons use Signal Orange bg with White text. Secondary uses Glass effect.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form components. Inputs should have bg-black/20 with border-white/10 to sink into the glass panels.

motion.interactions: Hover states: slightly lighter glass (bg-white/10), scale up (scale-[1.02]).
motion.transitions: Explicit transitions only. Use 'transition-colors duration-200' or 'transition-transform duration-300 ease-out'. Avoid 'transition-all'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over glass meets APCA minimums. Add text-shadow or inner glow if background is too bright.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-btn', data-testid='lang-toggle').

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react. Industrial, technical, clean strokes.
media.charts: Use Recharts for KPI monitoring, Budget, and Order schedules. Keep tooltips styled with liquid glass.

industrial_fans.description: gray and black fan turned on in close up photography

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI components but strip default Vercel look. Restyle tables and inputs to have the liquid glass aesthetic using Tailwind backdrop-blur and borders.
Implement language toggle (Russian/English) prominently in the header or sidebar.
Ensure 'lucide-react' or 'phosphor-icons' are used consistently for a technical corporate look.
Use sonner for toast notifications (import from /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js).
Avoid centering layouts. Align left for data-heavy sections.
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn equivalents.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (12-24px blur).
Never apply universal transition (transition: all) to prevent breaking transforms.
Never center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
Do not use AI emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons.
Include micro-animations for all interactive elements (hover states, entrance).
